caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a round body, a narrow neck, and a handle connecting the top of the neck to the body. The jug is predominantly a light beige or tan color, with subtle shading to suggest texture and volume. There is a prominent decorative blue label on the upper portion of the jug with cursive text that reads "Milwauk. 1856." The blue label is bordered by a wavy, scalloped pattern and the text appears hand-painted. Above the label, there is a smaller amount of lettering, possibly including the potter's or manufacturer's information. The handle is positioned on the right side of the neck. The background is plain and off-white, with some areas showing faint stains or discoloration. The overall composition centers the jug on the page, with the base of the jug appearing to rest lightly on the lower edge of the drawing.
title: Jug
